description: Track a brand's visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude): mention rate, citation rate, share of voice and position over time. Requires Starter ($5/mo) or higher. Monthly allowance (checks / tracked prompts): Starter 150 / 15, Basic 500 / 30, Pro 1,500 / 75, Ultra 4,000 / 200. A check is one prompt on one engine, sampled once. With no prompts, pass `starter` and a starter set is generated to fit the plan.

engines.description: Default: gpt, gemini, perplexity, claude. gpt answers from the model's own knowledge (no browsing); chatgpt is the web-search product and needs an OpenAI key on the server.

name: create_citation_tracker
